checks.label: Tracker icon family contains the five primary scenes
You tab has profile dashboard, snapshots and quick access
You tab retains editable profile and sign out
Workout has guided choose, configure and start flow
Workout retains saved plans, preview, active recovery and reordering
Workout retains movement guidance and Android Back handling
Journey has period hero, progress and prior-period comparison
Journey retains weekly/monthly reporting and pull to refresh
Supplements has routine, calendar, daily check-in and schedule
Supplements retains reminder and status actions
Supplements includes younger-account support wording and no dose recommendations
Add Meal matches Food visuals and offers meal, search and quick-add steps
Add Meal retains recent, saved, custom, barcode and verified paths
Younger Food accounts remain a neutral journal without nutrition search or targets
Food retains pull to refresh and hardware/software Back support
